title: SOBO vs MOBO for the balancing parameters of SCO-FCM: code, processed LMArena data, and experimental logs
description:
Code, processed data, and experimental logs for the paper "Comparing Single- and Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Soft-Constrained Fuzzy Clustering in Large-Scale Group Decision Making" by I. Lazulfa, T. Widiyaningtyas, and D. D. Prasetya (Universitas Negeri Malang).

The study tunes the three balancing parameters (zeta, kappa, mu) of the soft-constrained fuzzy clustering method SCO-FCM for large-scale group decision making, using 1,149 LMArena raters and 30 models, and compares single-objective Bayesian optimization (GP + EI) with multi-objective Bayesian optimization (GP + EHVI) over 20 paired replications. The archive contains the SCO-FCM pipeline, the optimizers, the analysis scripts, the processed rater-profile matrix, and every logged evaluation. The raw votes are not redistributed; the preparation script downloads them from lmarena-ai/arena-human-preference-100k on Hugging Face.
